meta.aquacropConvention: season 1 Apr Y .. 31 Mar Y+1; initial water at wilting point (dry) or field capacity (fc) on 1 Apr; default crop parameters
meta.simulatorSetup: texture loam of the simulator (AquaCrop: its own default Loam, a different profile; cases with a site field: the SoilGrids soil of that pilot, same thetaFC/thetaWP in both models), flat slope, rainfed, dry start on 1 April, single crop with fixed sowing date
meta.classSoilNote: Cases with soil Loam, Sand or Clay are NOT the same soil in both models: AquaCrop uses its own default class profile and the simulator its own class (see soilComparison). Only the site-soil cases (soil "site" / SoilGrids) give both models the same thetaFC and thetaWP. The headline maiz_0520 compares each model with its own loam.
meta.relYieldScale: simulator relYield: 0-1, relative to no water stress (stage-multiplicative for maize and beans, seasonal Ky for the other crops)
meta.note: AquaCrop uses default crop parameters (no local calibration): this tests logic and robustness, not field truth. Do not quote AquaCrop absolute yields. AquaCrop relYield = yield / max over the case years.

rainSensitivity.note: Gap days of a product are never filled; years with a gap in any product are excluded from all of this comparison. The model keeps ERA5 as its rain source: this quantifies an information gap, it is not a choice of product.

soilComparison.note: Class soils (Loam, Sand, Clay) are NOT the same soil in AquaCrop and in the simulator: AquaCrop uses its own default profile (read from the aquacrop package), the simulator its own class. Only the site-soil cases give both models the same thetaFC and thetaWP (thetaSat and Ksat of a site soil are the harness defaults: thetaFC + 0.15 capped at 0.6, Ksat 500 mm/day).
